html:
Given integer radius n >= 0, a cell is inside if x*x+y*y <= n*n. Draw an inside cell only when at least one of its four neighbors is outside. Inspect the bounding square -n..n, preserve leading spaces, and trim trailing spaces.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    2
  ],
  "expected": [
    "  *",
    " * *",
    "*   *",
    " * *",
    "  *"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": [
    "*"
  ]
}
Hint

A boundary cell has a neighboring position outside the disk.

Complexity: O(n^2) time and output characters
